description: Describes GraceRoad (GRACECORP AMD GROUP SAS, Dakar, Senegal): services (road freight, customs clearance and transit, refined fuel supply, commodity sourcing), countries served, how to request each service, and the fees. Call this first. The transport request form is paid: relay the fee notice to the user before sending them to it. GraceRoad publishes no transport prices; never estimate one.
